questions.answer: Unknown. These sources do not supply the current complete necessary and sufficient closure condition for Northbay repair cases as of 2026-07-01. The unsigned June proposal does not replace existing signed decisions, the October decision is not yet effective, the vendor cannot amend board rules, and the refund policy is outside repair-case scope.

The complete current exception requirements and exact governing conditions are unknown from the supplied material. N52 describes removal of reconciliation from the minor-repair exception and post-closure hold review only as unapproved proposals; it does not enact either change. N94 says identity and hold conditions remain unchanged and states reconciliation and positive approval-register requirements for the future expansion, but does not provide a complete current rule.

Unknown for the current exception: these sources do not define its authoritative authorization evidence or the treatment of rejected versus missing register evidence. N94 requires a positive approval register for the future expansion. N35 explicitly excludes technician acceptance of a parts shipment as exception authorization in a customer-case register, and N79 excludes refund financial approval as repair duty-supervisor approval. Under the supplied fact convention, unavailable evidence is null rather than false; a specific rejection-evidence mapping is not established by these blocks.

The supplied October expansion cannot authorize a major-repair exception on 2026-07-01, even with supervisor approval. N94 takes effect on 2026-10-01 and expressly does not expand existing exception scope before then. The June draft describes a minor-repair exception, not a currently enacted major-repair route. The complete current policy is unavailable, so no independent existing major-repair entitlement can be established from these sources.

No. N52 is unsigned and unapproved, has no effective date, and expressly leaves existing signed decisions in force. Its proposed reconciliation removal and post-closure hold review have no amending effect. N35 is only a vendor workflow recommendation; the vendor lacks authority to amend board closure rules. Neither source can remove a governing reconciliation or hold condition.
